story_scenes.title: Dry Tillage & Canal Opening
story_scenes.narration: Farmers plough bare fields before sluices open; soil scatters moderate radar (-14 dB) with low 0.22 bare-earth NDVI.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Establish dry soil baseline upstream and inside Polonnaruwa paddies.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Rough ploughed earth produces diffuse radar backscatter.

causal_chain.explanation: Controlled dry tillage precedes seasonal reservoir canal release.

story_scenes.title: Healthy Irrigated Paddy Mirrors
story_scenes.narration: Canal sluices fill fields with 10 cm standing water. Radar plunges to -22.5 dB—AI checks geometry & rain to confirm healthy farming, not a flood disaster.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Sharply bounded field rectangles + moderate rain prove planned irrigation rather than river breach.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Prevents false-positive flood alerts over normal paddy transplanting.

causal_chain.explanation: Smooth 10 cm standing water bounces radar beams cleanly away.

story_scenes.title: Rice Stalk Corner-Bounce Surge
story_scenes.narration: Young vertical stems poking through water create a radar 'double-bounce' mirror corner, spiking brightness to +2.2 dB like city skyscrapers!
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Rising greenness (NDVI 0.62) confirms crops—stopping naive radar from calling farms urban sprawl.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Double-Bounce Crop Illusion decoded via green NDVI pairing.

causal_chain.explanation: Water-to-stem 90° angle reflects radar energy directly back to satellite.

story_scenes.title: Lush Heading & Cooling Canopy
story_scenes.narration: Full green canopy reaches 0.84 NDVI while transpiration cools field surfaces ahead of grain filling.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Optical greenness + ECOSTRESS cooling measure total biomass and water-use health.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Dense leaves block underlying water reflections.

causal_chain.explanation: Healthy rice transpiration lowers daytime land surface heat.

story_scenes.title: Drained Fields & Golden Harvest
story_scenes.narration: Paddies drain dry for harvest; greenness falls to golden straw (0.38) while radar settles back to dry stubble (-13 dB).
story_scenes.why_these_layers: SAR + Optical verify harvest completion across food-security districts.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Double-bounce corner signal disappears once fields are drained dry.

causal_chain.explanation: Draining standing water ends crop cycle cleanly.

illusion_summary: Standing rice stalks above water act like miniature metal radar corner-reflectors (+2.2 dB), mimicking concrete cities, while newly flooded fields mimic disaster inundation unless paired with irrigation timing & NDVI.
causal_summary: Highland Reservoir Release -> Canal Irrigation Paddy Flooding (-23 dB Mirror) -> Vertical Rice Stalk Double-Bounce (+2.2 dB Spike) -> Closed Green Heading (0.84 NDVI) -> Golden Harvest.

geo_features.label: Mahaweli System B/C Irrigation Artery
geo_features.detail: Controlled reservoir water flows northeast from Minipe & Elahera into Polonnaruwa paddy grids.

geo_features.label: Polonnaruwa Irrigated Rice Grid
geo_features.detail: Cycles cleanly from -23 dB flooded mirror -> +2.2 dB rice stalk corner bounce -> 0.84 NDVI grain.
